req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that PUT /tasks/{id} ignores any 'id' field in the request body and only mutates the task addressed by the URL path parameter. Tests must verify: (1) positive — a PUT with a body containing a different 'id' value still returns 2xx and the response id matches the URL id, not the body id; (2) negative — the task addressed by the URL is mutated (not some other task), confirming the body id is ignored; (3) boundary — sending id equal to the URL id (no conflict) still works correctly; (4) additional EP/DT cases covering the body id being a non-existent id, and verifying the original task at the body-supplied id is untouched. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact id values in responses, and verifying the state of both the target task and the task whose id was supplied in the body.

tests.name: test_put_body_id_ignored_response_id_matches_url
preconditions: Task with id=5 exists (title='Write project report', completed=false)
Task with id=99 does not exist in the pre-loaded dataset
actions: Send PUT /tasks/5 with JSON body {"id": 99, "title": "Updated title", "completed": true}
Inspect response status code and body id field
expected: Response body id == 5 (URL id), not 99 (body id)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base, SessionLocal
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=5, title='Write project report', description=None, completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,6,8,1,38,4)))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
r = client.put('/tasks/5', json={"id": 99, "title": "Updated title", "completed": True})
assert r.status_code == 200
body = r.json()
assert body['id'] == 5
assert body['id'] != 99
assert body['title'] == 'Updated title'
assert body['completed'] == True

tests.name: test_put_body_id_does_not_mutate_other_task
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists (title='Fix login bug', completed=false)
Task with id=2 exists (title='Book flight tickets', completed=true)
actions: Send PUT /tasks/7 with JSON body {"id": 2, "title": "Hijacked", "completed": false}
Then GET /tasks/2 to verify task 2 is unchanged
Then GET /tasks/7 to verify task 7 was updated
expected: GET /tasks/2 returns HTTP 200 with title=='Book flight tickets' (unchanged)
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base, SessionLocal
from app import models
from datetime import datetime

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54)))
db.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.', completed=True, created_at=datetime(2025,5,12,18,49,0)))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)
r_put = client.put('/tasks/7', json={"id": 2, "title": "Hijacked", "completed": False})
assert r_put.status_code == 200
assert r_put.json()['id'] == 7
assert r_put.json()['title'] == 'Hijacked'

r2 = client.get('/tasks/2')
assert r2.status_code == 200
assert r2.json()['id'] == 2
assert r2.json()['title'] == 'Book flight tickets'

r7 = client.get('/tasks/7')
assert r7.status_code == 200
assert r7.json()['id'] == 7
assert r7.json()['title'] == 'Hijacked'

tests.name: test_put_url_task_not_found_returns_404_regardless_of_body_id
actions: Send PUT /tasks/888 with JSON body {"id": 3, "title": "Ghost update", "completed": false}
Verify 404 is returned (URL task not found), task 3 is untouched
expected: GET /tasks/3 still returns original task 3 data unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import engine, Base, SessionLocal
from app import models
